notes: Antidiabetic drug-class tagging from Part D claims. Keeps the author's DATA step verbatim: it screens each claim's brand name (bn) and generic name (gnn) with the SAS `in:` prefix operator and upcase() to set eight 0/1 drug-class flags (insulin, metformin, DPP-4, GLP-1, SGLT2, sulfonylurea, TZD, alpha-glucosidase), then the PROC SQL max() rollup that collapses to one row per beneficiary. The DUA-protected source ad.all_claims_with_ad is replaced with a small synthetic claims table whose bn/gnn values are the real drug names the script matches on. Closes with PROC PRINT of the per-beneficiary flags and PROC MEANS sum/n of class use.
